messages:
claire_design: dropped a compact popover proposal for the run row that shows a one-line signature + a 1-line sample output. trying to keep run history dense. mock: https://redwood.mock/s/popover-mini-signature.png josh_devex: looks tidy. quick question: when the popover opens, does keyboard focus move into it or stay on the run row? mobile behaviour? claire_design: plan: focus moves into popover on open (so keyboard users can tab the actions). on mobile it anchors and stays as a small sheet. will add aria notes. priya_pm: product note: whatever we do, we must keep immutable audit traces: show an inline provenance summary in the run row and include an event in the audit log. avoid any affordance that implies retroactive change of past outputs. marta_a11y: accessibility nits: the popover should have role=dialog and aria-modal=false (non-blocking). add `aria-label=\"Signature preview for run 2145000000\"`, and ensure the popover heading is focusable and announced. Provide an aria-live polite region for status messages (e.g., \"Override saved\"). Also avoid icons-only controls without aria-label. nate_engineer: implementation snippet we can reuse (minimal): ```html
sig: summarize(text: string) -> {summary: string}
sample: \"Short summary...\"
Open details
``` lucy_research: ran a 12-person probe: users liked popover for glanceability. key findings: people expected an explicit CTA for applying the change to future runs (wording matters). they preferred \"Apply to subsequent runs\" over \"Apply now\" or \"Use override\". also many wanted a short undo window (20-30s). priya_pm: agree on copy: use \"Change tool\" for the primary action label, and in the confirmation toast use: \"Tool updated Rerun to apply Undo\". do NOT auto-rerun. telemetry: emit tool_swap and tool_apply events. marta_a11y: microcopy: ensure aria-labels include run identifier or time so screen reader users know which run is affected (e.g., \"Change tool for run at 2026-03-22 11:00\"). toast must use role=status and be reachable via keyboard. nate_engineer: backend note: emit audit record immediately on swap: {run_id:2145000000, from: 'short-lm', to: 'summarizer-v2', actor: 'claire_design', ts:2145000000, pending: true}. UI shows pending tag until rerun applies. Undo flips pending and emits undo event. claire_design: will update mock to include provenance text in the row, accessible popover heading, and toast copy. default behaviour: popover opens with focus, small sample output visible, \"Change tool\" button + \"Open details\" link. add Undo in toast for 25s. ci-bot: ci-bot: playground/popover-mini-signature branch deployed to staging (build 9977)
